alate: Head densely haired, oval, wider than long, fontanelle large and oval, compound eyes large, nearly circular and projecting, ocelli small and oval; the apical tooth of the mandibles distinctly larger than the first marginal tooth, the third and first marginal teeth of the left mandible meeting at an angle; antennae with 15 segments; pronotum as wide as the head or slightly narrower; tibial spur formula 3:2:2, tarsi with four segments.
soldier: Head yellow with the posterior part paler, labrum pale, mandibles reddish brown, antennae and pronotum pale yellow, abdomen milky white. Head densely covered with short hairs, with a few long hairs scattered among them; the surface of the pronotum with only a few long hairs, its periphery with sparse long hairs; the abdomen especially densely covered with short hairs, the dorsum of every abdominal segment clothed with short hairs.
